channel.title: DailyBite: Daily Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Top Pick: Panera Bread: Second Entree for $5 with Code BOGO5
item.guid: Panera Bread-Second Entree for $5 with Code BOGO5-2026-08-21
item.description: Order any entree online or in-app, add a second entree, and apply code BOGO5 at checkout to get the second for $5 instead of full price. (Limited time)

item.title: Top Pick: Wingstop: 15-Piece Meal for 2 at $25 (Classic Bone-In Wings)
item.description: Order online or in the app for 15 classic bone-in wings in up to 2 flavors, large fries or veggie sticks, 2 dips, and 2 drinks for $25; choose classic (bone-in) at checkout. (Ongoing)

item.title: Safeway: $5 Sushi Friday: Zenshi 10-Piece Rolls
item.description: Every Friday, select Safeway locations with a sushi counter offer 10-piece Zenshi rolls for $5; free Just4U loyalty card required, while supplies last. (West and select states only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Harris Teeter: $5 Sushi Friday: Select Sushi Entrees
item.guid: Harris Teeter-$5 Sushi Friday: Select Sushi Entrees-2026-08-21
item.description: Harris Teeter offers select sushi entrees at the prepared-food counter for just $5 on Fridays at most locations; free VIC loyalty card required, while supplies last. (Southeast and Mid-Atlantic only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Subway: Two Footlong Subs for $12.99 with Code 1299FL
item.guid: Subway-Two Footlong Subs for $12.99 with Code 1-2026-08-21
item.description: Use code 1299FL on the Subway app or website to get two footlong subs for $12.99 total; great value for two people, pickup order at participating locations. (Through September 12, 2026)

item.title: Chili's: 3 For Me: Drink, Starter, and Entree from $10.99
item.guid: Chili's-3 For Me: Drink, Starter, and Entree fro-2026-08-21
item.description: Choose a non-alcoholic drink, an appetizer or side salad, and a full entree from the 3 For Me menu starting at $10.99; upgrade tiers go up to $16.99 for sirloin or pasta. (Ongoing)

item.title: Subway: Any Footlong for $6.99 with Code FOOTLONG699
item.guid: Subway-Any Footlong for $6.99 with Code FOOTLON-2026-08-21
item.description: Apply promo code FOOTLONG699 on the Subway app or website at checkout and get any footlong sub for $6.99; select participating locations, pickup order. (Through September 12, 2026)
